question: Under the frozen five-source V1.1 event trains, can amplitude versus charge-preserving timing compression explain absent KC spikes?

cohorts.old_59: all KCs with direct pair from 13285/13707/13874
cohorts.none_28: the remaining selected KCs, retained in the full-107 summary

compression.center: per-KC midpoint of first and last observed visual arrival
compression.timestamp_rule: center + (event_time-center)/factor, rounded half-even to nearest 500-us tick

synchrony_upper_bound.timing: all existing per-KC visual events at the nearest 500-us tick to its original first/last midpoint

charge_contract: Keep every source row, event count and event amplitude in timing families. Infinite-horizon delivered charge is 5 ms times summed event-step pA. Finite 500-ms charge is also reported and must agree within numerical tolerance because the last observed arrival is before 200 ms.
first_spike_policy: Analytical frozen passive LIF trajectory until first threshold crossing; scan the frozen 500-us threshold ticks in the half-open 500-ms post window. If threshold is crossed, report first spike only; do not infer network feedback or later spikes.
full_model_confirmation: Reproduce observed B5.4 KC peak voltage/current/charge at every one of 30 nominal checkpoints and perform independent scalar audit of counterfactual first-spike arithmetic; no production simulation parameters change.
primary_endpoint: Per-KC first spike at exact 1x current for observed, four compression factors and synchronous upper bound; first tested multiplier in the complete amplitude ladder at observed timing.

classification_predeclared.amplitude_limited: Fewer than 8 of 79 contacted KCs spike at 1x under every finite compression through 16x, fewer than 40 spike even under perfect synchrony, and the median observed critical amplitude multiplier is at least 10x; amplitude-ladder spikes must exist. This is an effective-drive classification within the surrogate, not identification of synaptic efficacy versus intrinsic excitability.
classification_predeclared.temporal_integration_limited: At least 40 of 79 contacted KCs spike at 1x under at least one finite compression factor through 16x, with little or no amplitude scaling required in that timing family.
classification_predeclared.mixed: Between 8 and 39 of 79 spike at 1x under a finite compression factor and the contacted-population median critical amplitude multiplier falls by at least twofold relative to observed timing; otherwise timing evidence may be weak.
classification_predeclared.unresolved: Any pattern that does not meet the preceding mutually ordered criteria, any invalid charge/state replay, or evidence that the local passive model no longer applies. Report cohort-specific exceptions even when the overall label is amplitude-limited.

do_not: convert a diagnostic threshold into production weight
use game, motor, reward, plasticity or training
stop: Report B5.5 and one next Branch B stage; do not create V1.2.
